target_claim: Suppose we have a graph G with |V| vertices that has a minimum spanning tree.  Suppose we also have a set of |V| - 1 edges = <$e_1$, $e_2$, ..., $e_n$>, such that each edge is a light edge for some cut C, and these edges do not form a cycle.  This set of edges must form a minimum spanning tree.
source_quote: Suppose we have a graph G with |V| vertices that has a minimum spanning tree.  Suppose we also have a set of |V| - 1 edges = <$e_1$, $e_2$, ..., $e_n$>, such that each edge is a light edge for some cut C, and these edges do not form a cycle.  This set of edges must form a minimum spanning tree.
